is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus and Anopheles arabiensis (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper explicitly states on page 6: 'Since no kdr mutation tests were done, it is not possible to determine whether these observations were associated with the voltage-gated sodium channel protein mutation'.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data for insecticide resistance markers; it only reports phenotypic bioassay results.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from three villages in south-eastern Tanzania (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting bioassays on field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies three villages: Ikwambi, Sululu, and Tulizamoyo (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were done from September 2018 to November 2019 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections performed between 2018 and 2019.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data for the reported bioassays is contained within the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study compared insecticide resistance phenotypes (bioassays) of Anopheles funestus and Anopheles arabiensis in three villages in south-eastern Tanzania. While it performed molecular identification of sibling species, it did not genotype any insecticide resistance markers (kdr or others).
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper explicitly states no kdr mutation tests were performed.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype data for resistance markers is reported.
